runtime_license_boundary.detail: The Cargo graph passes. The production static image still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode and incompletely reviewed runtime inputs. Experimental GNU server 10efeb22 uses external std and OpenSSL 3, has hashes for all 1,439 mapped source paths, and passed container, HTTPS, outbound TLS, and native HLS restart checks. Its external std contains non-allowlisted components and must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped content, external-runtime distribution, and production adoption remain uncleared; see runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 104 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 038eba61 passed 31 container and 29 local HTTPS checks. Bounded multi-field sorting, item exclusions, visible artist filters, album grouping, local-NFO disc/track numbers and hidden-parent ordering have PostgreSQL coverage. Official web displays the correctly ordered two-disc album and exactly two other same-artist albums. Official Qt 6 Desktop in the retained private software-rendering profile plays all three original AIFF tracks from the album Play control, advances automatically through audio EOF and independently retains completion. Earlier resume, Instant Mix, video, playlist and photo checks retain their image-specific scope in acceptance.md. ContributingArtistIds remains unsupported and artist Appears On can include unrelated visible albums. Embedded music tags, general Desktop startup reliability, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, longer converted audio, audible quality, and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete or unvalidated. Collections covers containing ancestors only; management and arbitrary membership remain incomplete. A first native three-track run on this image decoded every track through EOF but underreported one final position and failed saved completion. The unchanged repeat passed; native completion-report reliability remains unresolved.
